Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a two-vehicle collision in Baytown, Texas, where Driver 1 was turning left across traffic when
the front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the driver's side. Driver 1 was operating the vehicle with Passenger seated
beside them. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain at the scene and was evlauated by medical personnel. The
described injuries are consistent with the direction and force of the impact. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred
as Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses gave statements that match that account. Scene photographs
show damage that is largely consistent with the reported impact pattern. Officers confirmed Passenger was present in
the vehicle at the time of the crash, and both witnesses identified Passenger as an occupant. Driver 1 is listed as the
named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Responding officers found no indication of prior damage to the
vehicle, and none was reported by any party. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review of the
statements and photographs.
</page>
